children: MEXICO CITY--Mexico's economic activity rose in the third quarter, led by growth in services in a second straight period of expansion following a negative start to the year, national statistics institute Inegi said Monday.

Gross domestic product, a measure of output in goods and services, expanded 0.9% from the second quarter in seasonally adjusted terms. Services grew 1.2%, industrial output increased 0.4% and agricultural production rose 0.3%,

Growth in industrial production was revised down from 0.8% in Inegi's preliminary estimate at the end of October, while services were revised up from 1.1% and agricultural production was revised up from a previously reported 0.4% contraction.
The July-September period marked a second consecutive quarter of growth following a weak start to the year, but a slowdown from the 1.6% increase in the second quarter.

Third-quarter economic output was up 3.3% unadjusted from the year-earlier quarter, bringing economic growth for the first nine months of the year to 1.9%, on track to outpace the 0.7% growth in all of 2025.
